correctness.rationale: Exact partition-lattice inversion follows from grouping nonempty right-shore neighborhoods by coarsening partition. The only terms surviving modulo four have one or three blocks; Stirling parity yields W congruent to (-1)^(m+n), nonzero at every Fourier character. Constructive signs for shores 2 and 3 attain absolute value one. A separate union-find enumeration and integer Walsh transform match a 15-partition inversion computation pointwise on all 65536 sign matrices for K4,4, with Parseval and 49-level histogram checks. These certify minimum three, maximum 36317 and sharp inverse condition number.
